text:
marta: Quick handoff — APAC pool is seeing a rising queue from a scheduled NovaAI batch. Not an incident, just wanted to flag for the night team. :eyes:

oncall-bot: [autosummary] pool=apac-gpu-1 utilization=88% queued=42 headroom=12% burst_limit=0.8 older_jobs=3

alex: thanks — ETA on queue drain? any long-running jobs?

marta: Most are medium jobs (30-90m). NovaAI kicked off ~20 jobs at 21:10 JST. They look standard but high concurrent. No retries yet.

sam: copying logs, running quick check:
```
rictl pool describe apac-gpu-1 --json | jq '.jobs | map({id: .id, status: .state, runtime_minutes: .runtime_minutes})'
```

sam: result shows 8 >60m, 18 between 20-40m, rest short.

lee: propose temporary burst throttle to 0.6 and bump eviction-priority for >75m jobs to make room. Thoughts?

arjun: I prefer throttle first, eviction is risky for those jobs' SLAs. We can also enable prefix-caching to reduce token work on streaming jobs (if any).

marta: agree with throttle. I'll apply burst_limit=0.6 for apac-gpu-1 now, will monitor for 20m. If queue stays >40 after 30m we can escalate to eviction-policy step.

oncall-bot: command executed by marta: set-pool-config apac-gpu-1 {"burst_limit":0.6} — queued jobs unaffected but new dispatch will respect limit

alex: pinging @sam — can you watch for backpressure to other regions? we don't want jobs to pile into eu-west.

sam: watching. currently eu-west pool utilization=46% and no spike. will alert if >70% in next 15m.

lee: also note NovaAI support message in intercom: they said they might re-run a few failed pieces at 02:00 UTC. put that on the radar for the overnight shift.

arjun: added a short runbook note to the oncall doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/apac-queue-guidance (see section 3 for throttle+eviction thresholds)

marta: handoff for night: I'll be offline 02:00-06:00 UTC. @alex will cover first 2 hours, @lee covers 04:00-08:00 UTC. please escalate to infra-pager if queue growth is accompanied by increased OOMs or dispatcher errors.

alex: got it. if anything weird, I’ll drop a message here and ping infra-pager.

oncall-bot: [reminder] scheduled job: NovaAI batch at 02:00 UTC (possible reruns)

sam: small ask — if queue persists after 01:00 UTC, consider temporarily enabling the low-priority burst lane (policy: allow up to 10 low-priority slots) to keep latency for interactive customers.

marta: noted. we'll try throttle + eviction before enabling low-priority lane to avoid impact.

lee: FYI I ran a quick cost check: enabling low-priority lane could bump short-term GPU usage by ~12% — team ok with that if it prevents customer-visible slowdowns?

arjun: thumbs up from product-side if it prevents retries. but prefer controlled throttle first.

marta: thanks all. leaving the thread open — will post a 22:00 JST status update. :thumbsup:
